author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
In this video, I’m visiting one of China’s most unreachable villages.
Hidden deep inside a massive sinkhole, this village was once cut off from the outside world. For generations, the only way to get here was a difficult hike down into the valley, with no roads leading in or out.
But today, everything has changed. China has built a 100-floor elevator through the cliffs, turning this once-isolated village into one of the most unusual places you can reach.
